text.hi: नकारात्मक वाक्य में not सहायक क्रिया के बाद आता है: They are not coming। छोटा रूप: doesn't, didn't, weren't, wasn't, isn't, don't, haven't।
text.hinglish: Nakaaraatmak vaakya mein not sahaayak kriya ke baad aata hai: They are not coming. Chhota roop: doesn't, didn't, weren't, wasn't, isn't, don't, haven't.
text.en: In a negative sentence, not comes after the helping verb: They are not coming. Short forms: doesn't, didn't, weren't, wasn't, isn't, don't, haven't.
